11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
12	
13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
17	
18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
23	-/

34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
42	
43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/

47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
55	      apply Subtype.ext
56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm

58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

68	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}

112	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
113	
114	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
115	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
116	relative-open gate below. -/
117	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
118	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
119	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
120	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
121	
122	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
123	
124	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
125	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
126	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
127	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
128	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)

132	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
133	
134	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
135	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
136	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
137	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/

139	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
140	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
141	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
142	  W : X.Opens
143	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
144	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
145	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
146	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
147	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
148	    (w : S ⟶ X),
149	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =

151	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
152	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
153	
154	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
155	
156	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
157	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
158	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
159	
160	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
161	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
162	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
163	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
164	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
165	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
166	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
167	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
168	      φ.app S) D.sq
169	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
170	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
171	  · intro v w hvw
172	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
173	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
174	
175	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented

178	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
179	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
180	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
181	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
182	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
183	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
184	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
185	  intro X g
186	  let d := D X g
187	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
188

190	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
191	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
192	  h

194	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
195	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
196	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
197	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
198	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
199	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
200	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
201	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
202	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
203	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
204	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
205	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
206	  h.property g fst snd hpb
207	
208	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
209	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
210	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
211	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
212	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
213	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
214	
215	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
216	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
217	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
218	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
219	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
220	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
221	
222	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
223	
224	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
225	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
226	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
227	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
228	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
229	
230	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
231	representer. -/
232	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
233	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
234	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
235	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

238	def rankOneAbelAff :
239	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶

242

244	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
245	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
246	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
247	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
248	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
249

253	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=

10	
11	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean` proves `isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` over an
12	**affine** test, and its docstring says the general-test statement "follows from this one by the

14	claim is right, and this file discharges it — but two of its ingredients were not where the tree
15	said they were.
16	
17	## The advertised lemma that was absent
18	
19	`Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean`'s header says chart-independence of the residue field is free
20	"and the chart comparison becomes a lemma (`testPointField_affineOpen_iso`) instead of a side
21	condition.  That is the whole reason this file is short."  **No declaration of that name exists
22	anywhere in the workspace** — the only occurrence was that sentence (cf. I-0624:
23	advertised-but-absent).  Since it is cited as the reason a side condition is unnecessary, it is
24	load-bearing prose, so it is supplied here as `testPointField_fromSpecAffine_isIso`.
25	
26	It is genuinely cheap, but not for the reason the header gives: what makes it work is that
27	`Over.fromSpecAffine T U` is an **open immersion** on carriers
28	(`IsAffineOpen.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec`), and mathlib already knows the residue-field map of an
29	open immersion is an isomorphism
30	(`Scheme.instIsIsoCommRingCatResidueFieldMapOfIsOpenImmersion`).  So the comparison is an
31	iso for a structural reason, not by a computation with `Spec.residueFieldIso`.
32	
33	## Locality: what "open in every affine piece" needs
34	
35	`isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open`-style bookkeeping is not quite enough, because the locus over the
36	piece is a subset of a *different* space (`Spec Γ(T.left, U)`, not `T.left`).  The bridge is that

/-!
# Descent of the canonical rank-one divisor from an étale witness

Assuming the rank-one divisor **uniqueness interface** (`RankOneDivisorUniqueness`): over any
affine test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened divisor class has
that Abel value — the missing-item interface to be discharged by a later session.

Under this hypothesis, a widened divisor over the carrier of an étale cover of the test whose
Abel value is the restricted input class **descends uniquely** to the test algebra
(`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness`): uniqueness at the tensor square of the
carrier manufactures the two-coprojection agreement demanded by the faithfully-flat descent
theorem `DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq`, and the Abel value of the descended class
is pinned by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`.

The first consumer is the finite glue on a Noetherian presentation carrier
(`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`), whose Abel conjunct is exactly the
étale witness above.  The unique class is then extracted as the **canonical rank-one divisor**
of a presentation (`canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation`), with its Abel equation and
uniqueness accessors.

This file does not construct `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, does not prove independence of
the chosen presentation beyond what uniqueness already gives, and does not discharge the
uniqueness interface itself.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

/-- **The rank-one divisor uniqueness interface**: over every affine test whose plus class
lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally certified divisor class of degree
`genus C` has Abel value the input class.

This is the sanctioned missing-item interface of the canonical-divisor route: producers prove
existence (the finite glue and its descent below), while injectivity of the widened Abel map
on the rank-one locus is to be discharged by a later session.  Stated as a named `Prop` so
consumers can take it as a single hypothesis. -/
def RankOneDivisorUniqueness : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k S)),
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k S)) →
    ∀ F G : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C),
      abelDivAffPlus C S F = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 →
      abelDivAffPlus C S G = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 → F = G

/-- **Descent of an Abel-correct divisor witness along an étale cover**: a widened divisor

input rank-one plus class descends to a unique Abel-correct widened divisor class over `A`.

assumed: it is manufactured from the uniqueness interface, applied over the tensor square of
the carrier to the two coprojection pullbacks of the witness — both have Abel value the
restriction of the input class along the (single) structure map `A → E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier`,

the descended class is recovered by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
(`PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover`). -/
theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness
    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A))
    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (F' : DivFamZarAff C E.Carrier (genus C))
    (habel : abelDivAffPlus C E.Carrier F' =
      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) :
    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by

  set φ0 : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier := (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφ0
  set φL : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφL
  set φR : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφR
  set ψ : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier := φL.comp φ0 with hψ

  have hψR : φR.comp φ0 = ψ := by
    rw [hψ]
    exact AlgHom.ext fun a =>
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
        E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).trans
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).symm
  -- the input class restricted to the tensor square stays in the rank-one locus

    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op lam with hlam_sq_def
  have hlam_sq : lam_sq ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj
      (op (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier))) :=
    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op hlam
  have hsq : picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1
      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C ψ (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :=
    picEtAffineEquiv_naturality ψ lam.1
  -- both coprojection pullbacks of the witness have the restricted Abel value
  have habelL : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F')
      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φL F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, ← hψ]
  have habelR : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F')
      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φR F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, hψR]
  -- uniqueness over the tensor square manufactures the descent cocycle
  have htensor : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F' = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F' :=
    hu (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq hlam_sq _ _ habelL habelR
  obtain ⟨F, hF, -⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq E F' htensor
  rw [← hφ0] at hF
  -- the Abel value of the descended class, by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
  have hmapF : PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (abelDivAffPlus C A F)
      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
    rw [abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φ0 F, hF, habel]
  have habelF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
    apply PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover C E
    rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl,
      PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl] at hmapF
    exact hmapF
  exact ⟨F, habelF, fun G hG => hu A lam hlam G F hG habelF⟩

/-- **The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one local presentation**: over a rank-one
plus class with a tied local presentation on a Noetherian étale carrier, there is a unique
widened divisor class over the test algebra whose Abel value is the input class.

Existence: the finite glue
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation`
produces an Abel-correct witness over the presentation carrier, which descends by

over the test algebra whose Abel value is the presented rank-one plus class, chosen from
`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`.  By uniqueness, the choice does not
depend on the internal data of the glue — only on the class, the membership certificate,
